passages.text: Project Harborline is our bid to provide air-quality monitoring for 14 US warehouses of a large logistics operator. Sales Director Dana Whitcombe leads the bid.
Status as of August 2026: we passed the technical evaluation, and a pilot at 2 warehouses runs through October. The final award decision is expected in December 2026.
Our bid price is USD 1.32 million for 1,600 KS-400 units, including three years of support, at a 31% gross margin.
Tamberline Supply will handle installation at the warehouses. Customer Support lead Marcus Ellery owns the support plan for the pilot.
